paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者看到一小段工作终于有进展，安静地感到愉快，没有笑出声；当天也可能为另一个计划取消而难过。表现、感受与成果效果不同，两个感受不需要互相抵销。较多愉快回忆不证明调节能力或生活整体顺利。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a fictional reader feels quietly pleased at small progress without smiling outwardly, while also feeling sad about another cancelled plan. Expression, feeling and output effectiveness differ. Neither feeling cancels the other, and more recalled joy establishes neither regulation ability nor overall well-being.

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论卡：“只看虚构进展，发生了什么、感到什么、实际表达了什么，哪些仍未知？”可只读，不需制造开心事件或表现积极。听者不要求提高读数，也不以较低均值推断感恩、性格或健康。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion card separates the fictional progress, feeling, expression and unknown details. Reading alone suffices without creating happy events or performing positivity. A listener seeks no higher reading and infers neither gratitude, personality nor health from a lower mean.

Copying includes only the public title and entry, without answers, means or private events.

paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a fictional activity changes rooms and a reader briefly feels surprised before calmly finding the new location. Surprise, importance and effectiveness differ. Someone informed earlier may feel no surprise without demonstrating greater flexibility or emotional skill.

Reading alone creates no startle or novelty task. Surprise and anticipation need no complementary scores, and frequency establishes no curiosity.

A reader feels sad at the ending and pleased with the completed small goal. Both can remain without one true emotion. Sadness frequency compares no amount of loss, certifies no empathy and decides no relationship ending.

paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, an unannounced change to a fictional task agreement brings anger, while its cause remains unknown and the questionnaire observes no later speech. Feeling, interpretation and conduct differ. A reading decides no unfairness and justifies no harmful conduct.

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论卡：“虚构变化的已知事实、读者解释、感受与行动，哪些可以区分？”可只读，不制造争执、联系对方或要求道歉。听者不从较高均值推断领导力，也不从较低均值证明没有冲突。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion card distinguishes known events, interpretation, feeling and action in the fictional change. Reading alone creates no dispute, contact or apology requirement. Higher means establish no leadership; lower means prove no absence of conflict.

paragraphs.zh: 新增情境与讨论卡为费马编辑部原创，可只读，原有观察均可跳过。固定一个普通工作、学习或自愿小组场景，回顾过去四周；窗口是编辑约定。40条按八组各五条直接计入，无反向；1从不到5几乎每次相关机会，3是有时，不是中立或强度。不适用、记不清或不愿回答则不计分，不补零或中点。全部40条需回应，每组至少三条数字，用和除以数字项数，显示一位小数；2、4、3与两条未评分为9÷3＝3.0；两条数字不给该组均值，其他足够组保留，八篇全文始终可读。最低三条只是编辑完整度规则，小数不证明精度。均值不代表实际事件次数、机会百分比、强度、持续时间、能力或健康；相同均值可有不同机会和答案，变化不认证进步。八类不排名、不相加、不相减或派人格，理论上的相对类别也不强制数值互补。Plutchik理论是背景，未验证本原创题目、均值或回忆期；尚无已建立的信效度、常模或英中等值。虚构讨论无需披露、情绪诱导、重现不适、接触物品或联系他人。原有页面内存、自选24小时标签页草稿及完成退出重测清除不变，复制只含公开标题与入口，不含答案、均值或私人事件。
paragraphs.en: FermatMind Editorial authored these additions. Reading alone suffices and existing observations are optional. Keep one ordinary work, study or voluntary-group setting and recall four weeks, an editorial window. Forty direct prompts form eight groups of five without reversals. Anchors run from 1 Never to 5 Almost every relevant occasion; three means Sometimes, not neutrality or intensity. Inapplicable occasions, uncertain recall or withholding remain unscored without zero or midpoint replacement. All prompts need responses. Each group needs three numeric ratings for sum divided by numeric count, displayed to one decimal. Ratings 2, 4, 3 and two unscored give 9/3 = 3.0. Two numeric answers yield no mean for that group; sufficient groups and all eight full guides remain available. Three is an editorial completeness rule and decimal display establishes no precision. Means establish neither event counts, percentages of occasions, intensity, duration, ability nor health. Equal means can involve different opportunities and answers; changes certify no progress. Parts are neither ranked, added, subtracted nor used for personalities; conceptual opposites require no complementary numbers. Plutchik’s theory provides background without validating these original items, means or recall period. Reliability, validity, norms and English–Chinese equivalence are unestablished. Fictional discussion requires no disclosure, emotion induction, uncomfortable re-enactment, handling objects or contacting people. Existing page memory, optional 24-hour tab drafts and completion, exit or retake clearing remain unchanged. Copying includes only the public title and entry, without answers, means or private events.

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者期待项目下一阶段的消息，却还没有制定安排，后来消息内容也未必令人满意。向前期待、计划质量和结果成功分别需要理解。期待与对某个可能结果的不安可并存，不必相减或选主导情绪。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a fictional reader looks forward to project news without having made plans, and the eventual news may disappoint. Interested expectation, planning quality and success differ. Anticipation can coexist with apprehension about a possibility without subtraction or a dominant emotion.

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论卡：“虚构下一阶段里，期待的是哪部分，已经知道会发生什么，还有什么未知？”可只读，不安排活动、消费或反复重测。听者不从期待频率推断抱负、乐观、工作效率或未来成功。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion card separates what the reader looks forward to, what is known and what remains unknown in the fictional next stage. Reading alone requires no scheduling, purchases or repeated tests. Anticipation frequency establishes neither ambition, optimism, productivity nor future success.
